items.question: Trong câu "Search results must return within 1 second across 10,000 products.", từ "across" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Search results must return within 1 second across 10,000 products.", what does "across" (preposition) mean?
optionsEn: from one side to the other
over the whole of a set
items.explanation: across /əˈkrɒs/ (giới từ): trên toàn bộ (tập dữ liệu). "Across 10,000 products" = tính trên toàn bộ 10.000 sản phẩm; nghĩa gốc: băng qua (walk across the street).
items.explanationEn: across /əˈkrɒs/ (preposition): over the whole of a set. "Across 10,000 products" means over the whole set; the basic sense is "walk across the street".

items.question: Trong câu "BAs often miss NFRs because:", từ "miss" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "BAs often miss NFRs because:", what does "miss" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to fail to notice or include
to feel sad someone is away
items.explanation: miss /mɪs/ (động từ): bỏ sót. "Miss requirements" = bỏ sót yêu cầu; "miss" còn có nghĩa nhớ ai đó, lỡ chuyến xe.
items.explanationEn: miss /mɪs/ (verb): to fail to notice or include. "Miss requirements" means failing to include them; "miss" also means longing for someone or being late for a bus.

items.question: Trong câu "They don't appear directly on the UI", từ "appear" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They don't appear directly on the UI", what does "appear" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: appear /əˈpɪər/ (động từ): xuất hiện, hiện ra. "Appear on the UI" = hiện trên giao diện; nghĩa khác: "appear to be" = có vẻ là.
items.explanationEn: appear /əˈpɪər/ (verb): to become visible. "Appear on the UI" means being visible there; another sense is "appear to be" (seem).

items.question: Trong câu "Stakeholders don't say them out loud (but they expect them)", từ "out loud" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Stakeholders don't say them out loud (but they expect them)", what does "out loud" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: out loud /aʊt laʊd/ (cụm từ): nói thành lời, nói ra. "Say something out loud" = nói ra thành lời; ý là stakeholders ngầm kỳ vọng nhưng không nói.
items.explanationEn: out loud /aʊt laʊd/ (phrase): spoken so others hear it. "Say something out loud" means speaking it; stakeholders expect NFRs without stating them.

items.question: Trong câu "They only surface when the system breaks under real load", từ "surface" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They only surface when the system breaks under real load", what does "surface" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: surface /ˈsɜː.fɪs/ (động từ): lộ ra, xuất hiện. Động từ "surface" = lộ diện (problems surface); danh từ "surface" = bề mặt.
items.explanationEn: surface /ˈsɜː.fɪs/ (verb): to become known or visible. The verb "surface" means to come to light, as in "problems surface"; the noun means the outside layer.

items.question: Trong câu "They only surface when the system breaks under real load", từ "load" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They only surface when the system breaks under real load", what does "load" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the amount of work a system handles
items.explanation: load /ləʊd/ (danh từ): tải (lượng truy cập, công việc). "Under real load" = khi chịu tải thật; "load testing" = kiểm thử tải.
items.explanationEn: load /ləʊd/ (noun): the amount of work a system handles. "Under real load" means with real traffic; "load testing" checks this.

items.question: Trong câu "The consequence: developers build the right features, but the system is slow, crashes frequently, or is insecure — and nobody realizes this is a missing-requirement defect.", từ "consequence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The consequence: developers build the right features, but the system is slow, crashes frequently, or is insecure — and nobody realizes this is a missing-requirement defect.", what does "consequence" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a result, often a bad one
a way to solve a problem
items.explanation: consequence /ˈkɒn.sɪ.kwəns/ (danh từ): hậu quả. "The consequence" = hậu quả; "as a consequence" = do đó.
items.explanationEn: consequence /ˈkɒn.sɪ.kwəns/ (noun): a result, often a bad one. "The consequence" is the result; "as a consequence" means therefore.

items.question: Trong câu "The consequence: developers build the right features, but the system is slow, crashes frequently, or is insecure — and nobody realizes this is a missing-requirement defect.", từ "crash" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The consequence: developers build the right features, but the system is slow, crashes frequently, or is insecure — and nobody realizes this is a missing-requirement defect.", what does "crash" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: crash /kræʃ/ (động từ): bị sập, ngừng đột ngột. "The system crashes" = hệ thống sập; nghĩa gốc: đâm xe (a car crash).
items.explanationEn: crash /kræʃ/ (verb): to suddenly stop working. "The system crashes" means it suddenly stops; the basic sense is a vehicle collision.

items.question: Trong câu "The consequence: developers build the right features, but the system is slow, crashes frequently, or is insecure — and nobody realizes this is a missing-requirement defect.", từ "frequently" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The consequence: developers build the right features, but the system is slow, crashes frequently, or is insecure — and nobody realizes this is a missing-requirement defect.", what does "frequently" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: frequently /ˈfriː.kwənt.li/ (trạng từ): thường xuyên. Tính từ: frequent; danh từ: frequency (tần suất).
items.explanationEn: frequently /ˈfriː.kwənt.li/ (adverb): often. The adjective is "frequent"; the noun is "frequency".

items.question: Trong câu "The consequence: developers build the right features, but the system is slow, crashes frequently, or is insecure — and nobody realizes this is a missing-requirement defect.", từ "insecure" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The consequence: developers build the right features, but the system is slow, crashes frequently, or is insecure — and nobody realizes this is a missing-requirement defect.", what does "insecure" (adjective) mean?
options: không an toàn, dễ bị tấn công
items.explanation: insecure /ˌɪn.sɪˈkjʊər/ (tính từ): không an toàn, dễ bị tấn công. "An insecure system" = hệ thống thiếu bảo mật; với người: "feel insecure" = thiếu tự tin.
items.explanationEn: insecure /ˌɪn.sɪˈkjʊər/ (adjective): not protected from attacks. "An insecure system" lacks protection; for people, "feel insecure" means lacking confidence.

items.question: Trong câu "The consequence: developers build the right features, but the system is slow, crashes frequently, or is insecure — and nobody realizes this is a missing-requirement defect.", từ "defect" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The consequence: developers build the right features, but the system is slow, crashes frequently, or is insecure — and nobody realizes this is a missing-requirement defect.", what does "defect" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: defect /ˈdiː.fekt/ (danh từ): khiếm khuyết, lỗi. "A missing-requirement defect" = lỗi do thiếu yêu cầu; động từ "defect" /dɪˈfekt/ = đào tẩu.
items.explanationEn: defect /ˈdiː.fekt/ (noun): a fault or flaw. A "missing-requirement defect" is a fault caused by an absent requirement; the verb "defect" means to desert.

items.question: Trong câu "What is the maximum wait a user will accept for this screen?", từ "maximum" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What is the maximum wait a user will accept for this screen?", what does "maximum" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: maximum /ˈmæk.sɪ.məm/ (tính từ): tối đa. "Maximum wait" = thời gian chờ tối đa; trái nghĩa: minimum.
items.explanationEn: maximum /ˈmæk.sɪ.məm/ (adjective): the largest possible. "Maximum wait" is the longest acceptable wait; the opposite is "minimum".

items.question: Trong câu "Which feature is on the "critical path" — where users abandon if it's slow?", từ "critical" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Which feature is on the "critical path" — where users abandon if it's slow?", what does "critical" (adjective) mean?
options: then chốt, quan trọng sống còn
items.explanation: critical /ˈkrɪt.ɪ.kəl/ (tính từ): then chốt, quan trọng sống còn. "Critical path" = luồng then chốt; nghĩa khác: "critical of" = chỉ trích.
items.explanationEn: critical /ˈkrɪt.ɪ.kəl/ (adjective): extremely important. "Critical path" is the most important flow; another sense is "critical of" (disapproving).

items.question: Trong câu "Which feature is on the "critical path" — where users abandon if it's slow?", từ "abandon" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Which feature is on the "critical path" — where users abandon if it's slow?", what does "abandon" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: abandon /əˈbæn.dən/ (động từ): bỏ dở, rời bỏ. "Users abandon" = người dùng bỏ đi; "cart abandonment" = bỏ giỏ hàng.
items.explanationEn: abandon /əˈbæn.dən/ (verb): to leave without finishing. "Users abandon" means they leave before finishing; "cart abandonment" is a common metric.

items.question: Trong câu "How many users can the system handle at the same time?", từ "handle" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How many users can the system handle at the same time?", what does "handle" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to cope with or deal with
items.explanation: handle /ˈhæn.dəl/ (động từ): xử lý, chịu được. "Handle 500 users" = chịu được 500 người dùng; danh từ "handle" = tay cầm.
items.explanationEn: handle /ˈhæn.dəl/ (verb): to cope with or deal with. "Handle 500 users" means coping with them; the noun "handle" is a grip.

items.question: Trong câu "How many users will be online at the same time during peak time?", từ "peak" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How many users will be online at the same time during peak time?", what does "peak" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: peak /piːk/ (tính từ): cao điểm. "Peak time/hours" = giờ cao điểm; danh từ "peak" = đỉnh núi.
items.explanationEn: peak /piːk/ (adjective): busiest, highest. "Peak time" means the busiest period; the noun "peak" is a mountain top.

items.question: Trong câu "What is the projected user growth over the next year?", từ "projected" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What is the projected user growth over the next year?", what does "projected" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: projected /prəˈdʒek.tɪd/ (tính từ): dự kiến, dự báo. "Projected growth" = tăng trưởng dự kiến; nghĩa khác của project: chiếu hình.
items.explanationEn: projected /prəˈdʒek.tɪd/ (adjective): estimated for the future. "Projected growth" is forecast growth; "project" can also mean showing an image on a screen.

items.question: Trong câu "What is the projected user growth over the next year?", từ "growth" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What is the projected user growth over the next year?", what does "growth" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: growth /ɡrəʊθ/ (danh từ): sự tăng trưởng. "User growth" = tăng trưởng người dùng; động từ: grow.
items.explanationEn: growth /ɡrəʊθ/ (noun): an increase in size. "User growth" is the increase in users; the verb is "grow".

items.question: Trong câu "If the system is down for 1 hour, what is the business loss?", từ "loss" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If the system is down for 1 hour, what is the business loss?", what does "loss" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: money or value that is lost
items.explanation: loss /lɒs/ (danh từ): sự thiệt hại, tổn thất. "Business loss" = thiệt hại kinh doanh; "data loss" = mất dữ liệu.
items.explanationEn: loss /lɒs/ (noun): money or value that is lost. "Business loss" is money lost; "data loss" means losing data.

items.question: Trong câu "Is there any time window where downtime is absolutely unacceptable?", từ "absolutely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Is there any time window where downtime is absolutely unacceptable?", what does "absolutely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: absolutely /ˌæb.səˈluːt.li/ (trạng từ): hoàn toàn, tuyệt đối. "Absolutely unacceptable" = tuyệt đối không chấp nhận được; nhấn mạnh tính từ theo sau.
items.explanationEn: absolutely /ˌæb.səˈluːt.li/ (adverb): completely, totally. "Absolutely unacceptable" means totally not acceptable; it strengthens the adjective.

items.question: Trong câu "Is there any time window where downtime is absolutely unacceptable?", từ "unacceptable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Is there any time window where downtime is absolutely unacceptable?", what does "unacceptable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unacceptable /ˌʌn.əkˈsep.tə.bəl/ (tính từ): không thể chấp nhận. Tiền tố un- + acceptable; trái nghĩa: acceptable.
items.explanationEn: unacceptable /ˌʌn.əkˈsep.tə.bəl/ (adjective): not allowed or tolerated. The prefix "un-" negates "acceptable".

items.question: Trong câu "Is a maintenance window allowed? When?", từ "maintenance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Is a maintenance window allowed? When?", what does "maintenance" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: work to keep a system running
items.explanation: maintenance /ˈmeɪn.tən.əns/ (danh từ): sự bảo trì. "Maintenance window" = khung giờ bảo trì; động từ: maintain.
items.explanationEn: maintenance /ˈmeɪn.tən.əns/ (noun): work to keep a system running. A "maintenance window" is a scheduled time for upkeep; the verb is "maintain".

items.question: Trong câu "Does the system process things correctly, even when errors occur?", từ "occur" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Does the system process things correctly, even when errors occur?", what does "occur" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: occur /əˈkɜːr/ (động từ): xảy ra. "Errors occur" = lỗi xảy ra; danh từ: occurrence. Trang trọng hơn "happen".
items.explanationEn: occur /əˈkɜːr/ (verb): to happen. "Errors occur" means they happen; the noun is "occurrence". More formal than "happen".

items.question: Trong câu "How does the system protect data and access?", từ "protect" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How does the system protect data and access?", what does "protect" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: protect /prəˈtekt/ (động từ): bảo vệ. "Protect data" = bảo vệ dữ liệu; danh từ: protection.
items.explanationEn: protect /prəˈtekt/ (verb): to keep safe from harm. "Protect data" means keeping it safe; the noun is "protection".

items.question: Trong câu "How hard is it to onboard a new dev?", từ "onboard" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How hard is it to onboard a new dev?", what does "onboard" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to get on a ship or plane
to help a new member get started
items.explanation: onboard /ˈɒn.bɔːd/ (động từ): hướng dẫn hội nhập (người mới). "Onboard a new dev" = giúp dev mới làm quen dự án; danh từ: onboarding.
items.explanationEn: onboard /ˈɒn.bɔːd/ (verb): to help a new member get started. "Onboard a new dev" means helping them get up to speed; the noun is "onboarding".

items.question: Trong câu "This is exactly why NFRs need to be defined early — changing the architecture later is very expensive.", từ "exactly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is exactly why NFRs need to be defined early — changing the architecture later is very expensive.", what does "exactly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: exactly /ɪɡˈzækt.li/ (trạng từ): chính xác là. "This is exactly why..." = đây chính là lý do...; dùng để nhấn mạnh.
items.explanationEn: exactly /ɪɡˈzækt.li/ (adverb): precisely. "This is exactly why..." emphasises that this is precisely the reason.

items.question: Trong câu "This is exactly why NFRs need to be defined early — changing the architecture later is very expensive.", từ "define" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is exactly why NFRs need to be defined early — changing the architecture later is very expensive.", what does "define" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: define /dɪˈfaɪn/ (động từ): xác định rõ. "Define requirements" = xác định yêu cầu; nghĩa khác: định nghĩa từ. Danh từ: definition.
items.explanationEn: define /dɪˈfaɪn/ (verb): to state clearly. "Define requirements" means stating them clearly; it also means giving a word's meaning. Noun: "definition".

items.question: Trong câu "This is exactly why NFRs need to be defined early — changing the architecture later is very expensive.", từ "expensive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is exactly why NFRs need to be defined early — changing the architecture later is very expensive.", what does "expensive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: expensive /ɪkˈspen.sɪv/ (tính từ): tốn kém. "Expensive" không chỉ về tiền mà cả công sức: thay kiến trúc về sau rất tốn kém.
items.explanationEn: expensive /ɪkˈspen.sɪv/ (adjective): costing a lot. "Expensive" covers effort as well as money: changing architecture late is costly.

items.question: Trong câu "A message queue (RabbitMQ, Kafka) to buffer requests", từ "buffer" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A message queue (RabbitMQ, Kafka) to buffer requests", what does "buffer" (verb) mean?
options: đệm, giữ tạm (để xử lý dần)
items.explanation: buffer /ˈbʌf.ər/ (động từ): đệm, giữ tạm (để xử lý dần). Hàng đợi "buffer requests" = giữ tạm yêu cầu khi tải cao; danh từ: a buffer (bộ đệm).
items.explanationEn: buffer /ˈbʌf.ər/ (verb): to hold temporarily for later. A queue "buffers requests" by holding them during spikes; the noun is "a buffer".

items.question: Trong câu "Fix: the architecture must be rewritten, taking several months", từ "rewrite" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Fix: the architecture must be rewritten, taking several months", what does "rewrite" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: rewrite /ˌriːˈraɪt/ (động từ): viết lại. "Be rewritten" = bị viết lại; một bản viết lại toàn bộ gọi là "a rewrite".
items.explanationEn: rewrite /ˌriːˈraɪt/ (verb): to write again. "Be rewritten" means written again; a full redo is called "a rewrite".

items.question: Trong câu "What is the maximum number of concurrent users this feature serves?", từ "concurrent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What is the maximum number of concurrent users this feature serves?", what does "concurrent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: concurrent /kənˈkʌr.ənt/ (tính từ): đồng thời. "Concurrent users" = người dùng đồng thời; khác với tổng số người dùng đăng ký.
items.explanationEn: concurrent /kənˈkʌr.ənt/ (adjective): existing at the same time. "Concurrent users" are online at the same moment, not the total registered.

items.question: Trong câu "How will the data grow over time?", từ "over time" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How will the data grow over time?", what does "over time" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: over time /ˈəʊ.vər taɪm/ (cụm từ): theo thời gian. "Over time" = dần theo thời gian; đừng nhầm với "overtime" (làm thêm giờ).
items.explanationEn: over time /ˈəʊ.vər taɪm/ (phrase): gradually as time passes. "Over time" means as time passes; do not confuse it with "overtime" (extra work hours).

items.question: Trong câu "Is there a specific peak time?", từ "specific" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Is there a specific peak time?", what does "specific" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: specific /spəˈsɪf.ɪk/ (tính từ): cụ thể, xác định. "A specific time" = một thời điểm cụ thể; trạng từ: specifically.
items.explanationEn: specific /spəˈsɪf.ɪk/ (adjective): particular, clearly identified. "A specific time" is a particular time; the adverb is "specifically".

items.question: Trong câu "Which feature is on the critical path and must be fast?", từ "critical path" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Which feature is on the critical path and must be fast?", what does "critical path" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: critical path /ˈkrɪt.ɪ.kəl pɑːθ/ (cụm từ): luồng then chốt. "On the critical path" = nằm trên luồng then chốt, chậm là mất người dùng.
items.explanationEn: critical path /ˈkrɪt.ɪ.kəl pɑːθ/ (phrase): the essential flow. "On the critical path" means on the essential flow, where slowness loses users.

items.question: Trong câu "Is there any transaction that must not fail midway?", từ "transaction" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Is there any transaction that must not fail midway?", what does "transaction" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: an exchange such as a payment
items.explanation: transaction /trænˈzæk.ʃən/ (danh từ): giao dịch. Giao dịch (thanh toán, đặt chỗ) phải hoàn tất trọn vẹn hoặc không xảy ra.
items.explanationEn: transaction /trænˈzæk.ʃən/ (noun): an exchange such as a payment. A transaction such as a payment must fully complete or not happen at all.

items.question: Trong câu "Is there any transaction that must not fail midway?", từ "midway" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Is there any transaction that must not fail midway?", what does "midway" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: midway /ˌmɪdˈweɪ/ (trạng từ): giữa chừng. "Fail midway" = lỗi giữa chừng; tương tự: halfway.
items.explanationEn: midway /ˌmɪdˈweɪ/ (adverb): halfway through. "Fail midway" means failing halfway through; similar to "halfway".

items.question: Trong câu "How much downtime per month can the business accept?", từ "downtime" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How much downtime per month can the business accept?", what does "downtime" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: time when a system is not working
items.explanation: downtime /ˈdaʊn.taɪm/ (danh từ): thời gian ngừng hoạt động. Trong IT, "downtime" = thời gian hệ thống sập; trong đời thường còn là thời gian rảnh.
items.explanationEn: downtime /ˈdaʊn.taɪm/ (noun): time when a system is not working. In IT, "downtime" is when a system is down; informally it also means free time.

items.question: Trong câu "How much downtime per month can the business accept?", từ "accept" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How much downtime per month can the business accept?", what does "accept" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: accept /əkˈsept/ (động từ): chấp nhận. "Accept downtime/risk" = chấp nhận thời gian ngừng/rủi ro; tính từ: acceptable.
items.explanationEn: accept /əkˈsept/ (verb): to agree to tolerate. "Accept downtime" means tolerating it; the adjective is "acceptable".

items.question: Trong câu "NFRs directly influence database design:", từ "directly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "NFRs directly influence database design:", what does "directly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: directly /daɪˈrekt.li/ (trạng từ): trực tiếp. "Directly influence" = ảnh hưởng trực tiếp; trái nghĩa: indirectly.
items.explanationEn: directly /daɪˈrekt.li/ (adverb): without anything in between. "Directly influence" means affecting without intermediate steps; the opposite is "indirectly".

items.question: Trong câu "NFRs directly influence database design:", từ "influence" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "NFRs directly influence database design:", what does "influence" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: influence /ˈɪn.flu.əns/ (động từ): ảnh hưởng, chi phối. "Influence design" = chi phối thiết kế; cũng là danh từ: have an influence on.
items.explanationEn: influence /ˈɪn.flu.əns/ (verb): to have an effect on. "Influence design" means shaping it; also a noun: "have an influence on".

items.question: Trong câu "NFRs directly influence database design:", từ "design" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "NFRs directly influence database design:", what does "design" (noun) mean?
options: bản thiết kế, cách tổ chức
optionsEn: the plan of how something is built
items.explanation: design /dɪˈzaɪn/ (danh từ): bản thiết kế, cách tổ chức. "Database design" = thiết kế cơ sở dữ liệu (bảng, index, quan hệ).
items.explanationEn: design /dɪˈzaɪn/ (noun): the plan of how something is built. "Database design" is how tables, indexes and relations are planned.

items.question: Trong câu "NFRs are not just a separate document — they should be built into each story's AC when relevant:", từ "separate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "NFRs are not just a separate document — they should be built into each story's AC when relevant:", what does "separate" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: separate /ˈsep.ər.ət/ (tính từ): riêng biệt, tách rời. Tính từ /-ət/, động từ /-eɪt/ (tách ra).
items.explanationEn: separate /ˈsep.ər.ət/ (adjective): apart from others. The adjective ends in /-ət/, the verb "separate" in /-eɪt/.

items.question: Trong câu "NFRs are not just a separate document — they should be built into each story's AC when relevant:", từ "document" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "NFRs are not just a separate document — they should be built into each story's AC when relevant:", what does "document" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: document /ˈdɒk.jə.mənt/ (danh từ): tài liệu, văn bản. Động từ "document" = ghi lại thành tài liệu; danh từ: documentation.
items.explanationEn: document /ˈdɒk.jə.mənt/ (noun): a written piece of information. The verb "document" means to record in writing; the noun "documentation" covers all docs.

items.question: Trong câu "NFRs are not just a separate document — they should be built into each story's AC when relevant:", từ "build into" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "NFRs are not just a separate document — they should be built into each story's AC when relevant:", what does "build into" (phrase) mean?
options: đưa vào, tích hợp sẵn trong
optionsEn: to include as a part of
items.explanation: build into /bɪld ˈɪn.tuː/ (cụm từ): đưa vào, tích hợp sẵn trong. "Be built into" = được tích hợp sẵn; tính từ liên quan: built-in.
items.explanationEn: build into /bɪld ˈɪn.tuː/ (phrase): to include as a part of. "Be built into" means included as a part; the related adjective is "built-in".

items.question: Trong câu "NFRs are not just a separate document — they should be built into each story's AC when relevant:", từ "relevant" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "NFRs are not just a separate document — they should be built into each story's AC when relevant:", what does "relevant" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: relevant /ˈrel.ə.vənt/ (tính từ): liên quan, phù hợp. "When relevant" = khi có liên quan; trái nghĩa: irrelevant.
items.explanationEn: relevant /ˈrel.ə.vənt/ (adjective): connected to the matter. "When relevant" means when it applies; the opposite is "irrelevant".

items.question: Trong câu "permanently removes the record from the database", từ "permanently" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "permanently removes the record from the database", what does "permanently" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: permanently /ˈpɜː.mə.nənt.li/ (trạng từ): vĩnh viễn. Hard delete xóa vĩnh viễn; trái nghĩa: temporarily.
items.explanationEn: permanently /ˈpɜː.mə.nənt.li/ (adverb): forever. A hard delete removes data forever; the opposite is "temporarily".

items.question: Trong câu "Order data must be retained for at least 5 years for accounting purposes", từ "retain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Order data must be retained for at least 5 years for accounting purposes", what does "retain" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: retain /rɪˈteɪn/ (động từ): lưu giữ. "Retain data" = lưu giữ dữ liệu; danh từ: retention (data retention policy).
items.explanationEn: retain /rɪˈteɪn/ (verb): to keep. "Retain data" means keeping it; the noun is "retention", as in "data retention policy".

items.question: Trong câu "Order data must be retained for at least 5 years for accounting purposes", từ "purpose" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Order data must be retained for at least 5 years for accounting purposes", what does "purpose" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: purpose /ˈpɜː.pəs/ (danh từ): mục đích. "For accounting purposes" = cho mục đích kế toán; "on purpose" = cố ý.
items.explanationEn: purpose /ˈpɜː.pəs/ (noun): an aim or reason. "For accounting purposes" means for accounting reasons; "on purpose" means deliberately.

items.question: Trong câu "A user can restore deleted data within 30 days", từ "restore" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A user can restore deleted data within 30 days", what does "restore" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: restore /rɪˈstɔːr/ (động từ): khôi phục. "Restore deleted data" = khôi phục dữ liệu đã xóa; danh từ: restoration; "restore a backup".
items.explanationEn: restore /rɪˈstɔːr/ (verb): to bring back. "Restore deleted data" means bringing it back; also "restore a backup".

items.question: Trong câu "Search still works when 200 users search simultaneously", từ "simultaneously" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Search still works when 200 users search simultaneously", what does "simultaneously" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: simultaneously /ˌsɪm.əlˈteɪ.ni.əs.li/ (trạng từ): đồng thời, cùng lúc. "Simultaneously" = cùng lúc; gần nghĩa với "concurrently".
items.explanationEn: simultaneously /ˌsɪm.əlˈteɪ.ni.əs.li/ (adverb): at the same time. "Simultaneously" means at the same moment; close to "concurrently".

items.question: Trong câu "Results must not be cached for more than 1 minute (to reflect price updates)", từ "reflect" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Results must not be cached for more than 1 minute (to reflect price updates)", what does "reflect" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reflect /rɪˈflekt/ (động từ): phản ánh, thể hiện. "Reflect updates" = thể hiện kịp các cập nhật; nghĩa khác: suy ngẫm (reflect on), phản chiếu.
items.explanationEn: reflect /rɪˈflekt/ (verb): to show accurately. "Reflect updates" means showing them; other senses are "reflect on" (think) and mirror light.

items.question: Trong câu "Response < 3s is acceptable", từ "acceptable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Response < 3s is acceptable", what does "acceptable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: acceptable /əkˈsep.tə.bəl/ (tính từ): chấp nhận được. Hệ thống nội bộ ít người dùng thì phản hồi dưới 3 giây là chấp nhận được.
items.explanationEn: acceptable /əkˈsep.tə.bəl/ (adjective): good enough. For a small internal system, a response under 3 seconds is good enough.

items.question: Trong câu "Not a concern, the user count is fixed", từ "fixed" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Not a concern, the user count is fixed", what does "fixed" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: fixed /fɪkst/ (tính từ): cố định, không đổi. "The user count is fixed" = số người dùng cố định; "fixed" cũng là quá khứ của fix (đã sửa).
items.explanationEn: fixed /fɪkst/ (adjective): not changing. "The user count is fixed" means it does not change; "fixed" is also the past of "fix" (repaired).

items.question: Trong câu "Basic — auth, HTTPS, role-based access", từ "basic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Basic — auth, HTTPS, role-based access", what does "basic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: basic /ˈbeɪ.sɪk/ (tính từ): cơ bản. Mức bảo mật "basic" = cơ bản: xác thực, HTTPS, phân quyền theo vai trò.
items.explanationEn: basic /ˈbeɪ.sɪk/ (adjective): simple, essential. A "basic" security level means essentials: authentication, HTTPS, role-based access.

items.question: Trong câu "Handle a 5x spike during a Flash Sale", từ "spike" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Handle a 5x spike during a Flash Sale", what does "spike" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: spike /spaɪk/ (danh từ): sự tăng vọt đột ngột. "A traffic spike" = lượng truy cập tăng vọt; nghĩa gốc: gai, đinh nhọn.
items.explanationEn: spike /spaɪk/ (noun): a sudden sharp increase. "A traffic spike" is a sudden jump in load; the basic sense is a pointed object.

items.question: Trong câu "PCI DSS if card payments are involved", từ "involve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "PCI DSS if card payments are involved", what does "involve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: involve /ɪnˈvɒlv/ (động từ): liên quan, dính dáng đến. "If card payments are involved" = nếu có liên quan đến thanh toán thẻ; danh từ: involvement.
items.explanationEn: involve /ɪnˈvɒlv/ (verb): to be included or concerned. "If card payments are involved" means if they are part of it; the noun is "involvement".

items.question: Trong câu "Audit log for every transaction", từ "audit" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Audit log for every transaction", what does "audit" (noun) mean?
options: kiểm toán, kiểm tra ghi vết
items.explanation: audit /ˈɔː.dɪt/ (danh từ): kiểm toán, kiểm tra ghi vết. "Audit log/trail" = nhật ký kiểm tra, ghi lại ai làm gì khi nào.
items.explanationEn: audit /ˈɔː.dɪt/ (noun): an official check of records. An "audit log" or "audit trail" records who did what and when.

items.question: Trong câu "Encryption at rest and in transit, mandatory 2FA, audit trail", từ "mandatory" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Encryption at rest and in transit, mandatory 2FA, audit trail", what does "mandatory" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: mandatory /ˈmæn.də.tər.i/ (tính từ): bắt buộc. "Mandatory 2FA" = bắt buộc xác thực 2 lớp; trái nghĩa: optional.
items.explanationEn: mandatory /ˈmæn.də.tər.i/ (adjective): required by rules. "Mandatory 2FA" means two-factor login is required; the opposite is "optional".

items.question: Trong câu "Encryption at rest and in transit, mandatory 2FA, audit trail", từ "at rest" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Encryption at rest and in transit, mandatory 2FA, audit trail", what does "at rest" (phrase) mean?
options: khi lưu trữ (dữ liệu nằm yên)
items.explanation: at rest /æt rest/ (cụm từ): khi lưu trữ (dữ liệu nằm yên). "Encryption at rest" = mã hóa dữ liệu đang lưu trên ổ đĩa/DB; đối lập "in transit".
items.explanationEn: at rest /æt rest/ (phrase): while stored and not moving. "Encryption at rest" protects stored data; it pairs with "in transit".

items.question: Trong câu "Encryption at rest and in transit, mandatory 2FA, audit trail", từ "in transit" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Encryption at rest and in transit, mandatory 2FA, audit trail", what does "in transit" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in transit /ɪn ˈtræn.zɪt/ (cụm từ): khi đang truyền đi. "In transit" = đang được truyền qua mạng; nghĩa đời thường: hàng đang vận chuyển, quá cảnh.
items.explanationEn: in transit /ɪn ˈtræn.zɪt/ (phrase): while being sent. "In transit" means moving over a network; everyday use covers goods or travellers on the way.

items.question: Trong câu "Zero data loss, idempotent transactions", từ "idempotent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Zero data loss, idempotent transactions", what does "idempotent" (adjective) mean?
options: lặp lại vẫn cho cùng kết quả
optionsEn: giving the same result if repeated
items.explanation: idempotent /ˌaɪ.dəmˈpəʊ.tənt/ (tính từ): lặp lại vẫn cho cùng kết quả. Giao dịch idempotent: gọi hai lần cũng chỉ trừ tiền một lần.
items.explanationEn: idempotent /ˌaɪ.dəmˈpəʊ.tənt/ (adjective): giving the same result if repeated. An idempotent transaction charges only once even if called twice.

items.question: Trong câu "Use this checklist when starting a project or a large feature:", từ "checklist" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Use this checklist when starting a project or a large feature:", what does "checklist" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a list of items to verify
items.explanation: checklist /ˈtʃek.lɪst/ (danh từ): danh sách kiểm tra. Checklist giúp BA không bỏ sót NFR khi bắt đầu dự án.
items.explanationEn: checklist /ˈtʃek.lɪst/ (noun): a list of items to verify. A checklist helps the BA avoid missing NFRs at the start of a project.

items.question: Trong câu "Disaster recovery: if the primary server fails, what is the recovery time?", từ "primary" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Disaster recovery: if the primary server fails, what is the recovery time?", what does "primary" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: primary /ˈpraɪ.mər.i/ (tính từ): chính, chủ yếu. "Primary server" = máy chủ chính, đối lập "backup/secondary"; "primary school" = trường tiểu học.
items.explanationEn: primary /ˈpraɪ.mər.i/ (adjective): main, most important. "Primary server" is the main one, versus a backup or secondary; "primary school" is elementary school.

items.question: Trong câu "What is the maximum time to recover after an incident?", từ "incident" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What is the maximum time to recover after an incident?", what does "incident" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: incident /ˈɪn.sɪ.dənt/ (danh từ): sự cố. "Recover after an incident" = khôi phục sau sự cố; "incident response" = xử lý sự cố.
items.explanationEn: incident /ˈɪn.sɪ.dənt/ (noun): an unexpected problem event. "Recover after an incident" means getting back to normal; "incident response" handles it.

items.question: Trong câu "Which data is sensitive and needs encryption?", từ "sensitive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Which data is sensitive and needs encryption?", what does "sensitive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: sensitive /ˈsen.sɪ.tɪv/ (tính từ): nhạy cảm, cần bảo mật. "Sensitive data" = dữ liệu nhạy cảm (CCCD, tài khoản); nghĩa khác: dễ tủi thân.
items.explanationEn: sensitive /ˈsen.sɪ.tɪv/ (adjective): needing careful protection. "Sensitive data" needs protection (IDs, bank details); for people it means easily upset.

items.question: Trong câu "Which data is sensitive and needs encryption?", từ "encryption" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Which data is sensitive and needs encryption?", what does "encryption" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: encryption /ɪnˈkrɪp.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự mã hóa. Động từ: encrypt; ngược lại: decrypt (giải mã).
items.explanationEn: encryption /ɪnˈkrɪp.ʃən/ (noun): turning data into secret code. The verb is "encrypt"; the reverse is "decrypt".
